title: Implement CitationEnricher in alcanzai-understanding
description:
Salvage references (READ ONLY — reimplement to contract, never copy):
- prototype/paper_library/citation_context.py (320 lines)
- prototype/unintegrated_code/context/citation-context.py

Implement CitationEnricher against the Enricher protocol.

- enricher_id: 'citation-extractor'
- priority: 50 (runs after grobid-structure)
- applies_to: ContentType.ACADEMIC_PDF
- enrich(document): reads grobid_sections blocks from the in-progress enriched document (NOTE: coordinator passes the GROBID-enriched view); extracts bibliographic references from TEI references section; for each citation, finds context sentence(s) in body text where the reference marker appears; applies humanities-tuned garbage scoring.

CRITICAL behavioral requirement (carry forward from v0.1.x): garbage scoring must allow 50-100+ year old references to survive. The scoring is NOT a recency filter. Preserve the exact scoring logic and thresholds from prototype/paper_library/citation_context.py — this is one of the project's explicit design carry-forwards (DESIGN.md §3.2).

Returns EnrichmentResult(data={'citations': list[CitationRecord]}) where CitationRecord captures: title, authors, year, venue, volume, pages, raw_ref_string, context_sentences: list[str], garbage_score: float.

Acceptance:
- Unit test: given a known TEI XML block for 1706.03762, citation list is extracted; no valid reference is flagged as garbage.
- Humanities test: a reference to a work from 1850 (or 1920 or 1960) is NOT garbage-scored out.
